weekly_objective: Absorb Tuesday's hard double without digging a deeper fatigue hole — protect aerobic volume, strip out unnecessary intensity, and let the one remaining strength session land safely after a shortened long ride.
coach_says: Readiness dropped 23 points and TSB fell further since Sunday, and your anaerobic load is already well over target from Tuesday's double — so Thursday's sweet spot intervals are downgraded to an easy Z2 spin on the week's best-weather day, and Saturday's long ride is shortened rather than cancelled given the wet forecast and rising ATL. Sunday's strength session stays but with lighter target loads. Everything else this week is about consolidating the aerobic base you've already banked without adding more anaerobic stress.

days.session: Workout A — Hip Stability & Core (pre-hard-day friendly)
days.details: Workout A (lunch, 45 min). Warm-up: 5 min bike erg easy + glute bridges 2x12 + band lateral walks 2x10/side. Main: Single-leg Glute Bridge 3x10/side | Bulgarian Split Squat (bodyweight or light DB) 3x8/side | Pull-ups or Lat Pulldown 3x8 | Side Plank with Hip Dip 3x30s/side | Pallof Press 3x10/side | Copenhagen Plank 2x20s/side. Rest 60-90s between sets. Objective: hip stability, single-leg control and core stiffness with deliberately light lower-body loading — Tuesday is a key double hard day, so no heavy quad or spinal loading today.

days.session: Double: AM Hills Road Ride + PM Hard MTB Group Ride
days.details: AM (before work, ~60 min): Hills road ride | Primary objective: threshold climbing | Zone 4 on climbs. 15 min Z2 warm-up, then ride 4-5 hill repeats of 4-6 min at Zone 4 (RPE 8, hard but controlled), spinning easy on descents for recovery, 10 min Z1 cool-down. Ride steady between climbs — resist surging, since your anaerobic load is already over target. If rain makes the road unsafe, replicate on the trainer: 4x6 min @ 100-105% FTP, 4 min easy between. PM (after work, ~90 min): Hard MTB group ride — non-negotiable committed session. Ride to the group, fuel well between sessions (carbs at lunch and pre-ride), and don't add extra efforts at the end. This is the anaerobic stimulus for the week.

Mandatory recovery day after the Tuesday double. 45 min gentle yoga indoors (wet day anyway): emphasis on hip flexor openers, hamstring and glute stretches, thoracic rotation, and 5 min of slow breathing to finish. Nothing above conversational effort. Prioritise an early night — sleep history is your weakest readiness factor.

days.session: Easy-Moderate Z2 Endurance Spin (downgraded — recovery protection)
days.details: Total 60 min, no structured intervals | Zone 2 throughout (65-72% FTP, RPE 4-5, conversational). Best weather day of the week (dry, light wind, mild) — get outside and enjoy it, but this is deliberately downgraded from the original sweet spot session: readiness has dropped 23 points since Sunday and anaerobic load is already well over target, so there's no need to add threshold stress. 10 min easy spin to open up, 40 min steady Z2, 10 min easy cool-down. Keep cadence relaxed, no surges, no hills treated as efforts. This is about turning the legs over and banking easy aerobic time while you recover from Tuesday.

Lunch swim (wet day, pool is the smart choice). Warmup: 200m easy freestyle + 100m as 4x25m drill (catch-up or fingertip drag), 15s rest per 25. Main set: 8x50m aerobic freestyle at steady effort (RPE 5-6), 20s rest between reps; then 4x25m smooth build (easy to strong, not sprinting), 20s rest. Cooldown: 100m very easy mixed strokes. Total: 1000m. Objective: aerobic maintenance and upper-body recovery flush ahead of Saturday's ride — keep it genuinely easy, recovery is still the priority this week.

days.session: Shortened Long Endurance Ride Z2 (protected, not cancelled)
days.details: Total 2 h (shortened from the original 3 h) | Primary objective: aerobic-low volume without piling more strain onto a declining TSB | Zone 2 (65-75% FTP, RPE 4-5, conversational throughout). Both Friday and Saturday are forecast wet, so plan this on the trainer or as a shorter outdoor loop with rain layer/mudguards if there's a dry window. No intervals, no Z3 surges on climbs — stay seated and steady. Fuel 60-80 g carbs/hour. This still banks meaningful aerobic-low volume while respecting that readiness dropped 23 points this week and recovery_time is only 'moderate.'

days.session: Workout B — Posterior Chain Strength (tempered load)
days.details: Workout B (50 min, flexible timing). Warm-up: 5 min row or bike easy + bodyweight hinge patterning 2x10 + banded good mornings 2x12. Main: Romanian Deadlift 4x6 (moderate, RPE 6-7 — hold back from last block's top-end load given this week's fatigue trend) | Rear-foot Elevated Split Squat with DBs 3x8/side | Single-leg Hip Thrust 3x10/side | DB Row 3x10/side | Hanging Knee Raise 3x10 | Calf Raise (single-leg) 3x12/side. Rest 2 min on RDLs, 90s elsewhere. Objective: maintain the week's strength stimulus without chasing PRs — legs will feel Saturday's ride and the week's cumulative fatigue, so let bar speed and RPE guide load, not the number on the bar. Finish with 10 min easy stretching.
